parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualityMetricsAggregatorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity is high (0.778), the two methods — `calculatesAvgShaderFPS` (line 319) and `recordsInterpolatorResets` (line 461) — test distinct behaviours of `QualityMetricsAggregator` (shader FPS averaging vs. interpolator reset recording). Near-duplicate structure in test methods is common when tests follow a shared arrange-act-assert scaffold for the same subject under test, and collapsing them would obscure the distinct failure signals each test is meant to surface.
